defect.reproducer: Launch subscriber_reliability:=reliable with record:=false. The graph exposes /robot_a/sensor_pose; timeout 3s ros2 topic echo /robot_a/sensor_pose turtlesim/msg/Pose --qos-reliability reliable --once returns 124 and no Pose. The subscriber logs a zero receive count.
defect.root_cause: A BEST_EFFORT publisher cannot satisfy the RELIABLE subscription request. Both endpoints exist but their reliability policies are incompatible.
defect.proof_after: Restart with subscriber_reliability:=best_effort. Live echo returns 0 with Pose and the subscriber count increases. Record MCAP, stop the live launch, then play the same bag with config/qos-overrides.yaml. The only publisher is rosbag2_player with BEST_EFFORT; both echo and the separate BEST_EFFORT subscriber receive replayed Pose messages.
